correctness.rationale: The rate-(n−i)α exponential log-gaps give independent Beta((n−i)α,1) ratios. A violation is the event R_(i+1)(1+R_i)>1. The zero event detects every triangular triple, since the two immediate predecessors of any possible largest stick dominate any other pair below it; the count itself is only of consecutive triples. Conditioning yields q_i=a∫x^(a−1)[1−(1+x)^(−b)]dx. Expanding the exponential and x^a with one-sided remainders gives 0≤(π²/12)ab−q_i≤(3ζ(3)/4)a²b+(π²log(2)/24)ab². The adjacent joint probability is at most q_i β_(i+2) log 2. For an independent check of the process approximation: write F for the indicators through i−2 and J for I_(i−1). I_i is independent of F. The conditional deviation from q_i, averaged over J given F, equals 2|E[I_i J|F]−q_i E[J|F]|. Summing the expected deviations while replacing the conditional laws by independent Bernoulli(q_i) laws bounds process TV by 2Σ(P(I_i I_(i−1)=1)+q_i q_(i−1)); Poissonizing the independent coordinates costs O(Σq_i²). Coupling intensities adds at most their summed absolute difference. These give the claimed two error orders and apply even outside the critical regime (where the bound can be vacuous). Riemann sums give the stated density and mean π²λ/36, including the empty limit at λ=0. For supercritical n³α²→∞ with nα→0, the relative variance is O(1/(n³α²)+1/(n²α)); both denominators diverge. Capping α by n^(−4/3) preserves this regime and monotonicity of the uniform-ratio construction extends the conclusion. An independent algebraic recomputation confirmed the constants. CHECK.py was inspected, not executed; its frozen finite diagnostics are not a limit proof.

evidence: The fixed-n proof already uses disjoint log-gaps off adjacent sites and the same inclusion of an adjacent pair in a one-event intersection with a gap < log 2. In the fixed-n argument all disjoint pairs may be discarded at its error order; at n³α² of constant order their aggregate can instead be order one. The fixed-shape O_α(n log n) error likewise cannot be read uniformly toward zero shape.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The process result reuses those local ingredients and standard Poisson approximation, but needs parameter-tracked intensity error and retention of the independent rare events at disjoint sites. A separate monotone cap is needed to reach arbitrary supercritical sequences. The earlier endpoint statements do not imply the asserted uniform bound, rank law and full threshold merely by substituting parameters into them.

value.rationale: This identifies a natural noncommuting-limits problem: the window α on the scale n^(−3/2) determines when a first triangle can occur and whether complete avoidance is likely. The explicit rank intensity says where the consecutive-order violations concentrate, beyond a scalar avoidance probability, and the grid approximation supplies a quantitative finite-size law. It does not count all triangular subsets and its quantitative bound can be uninformative outside the sparse regime.
